description: Treat obstruction discovery like a held-out validation problem: mine on all but one parent family, then test on the withheld family. This is the fastest honest check that the atlas is structural rather than memorized.
mathematical_formalization: Partition parent families F = F_train union F_test and require coverage_train(C) high while coverage_test(C) remains nontrivial for the same core set C.
implementation_hypothesis: Define parent-family labels from symmetry and seed provenance, then score obstruction coverage on held-out families.
experiment_seed: Hold out the most non-Exoo-like parent family and compare recurrence counts against the training-only atlas.

closest_prior_art.title: Study of Exoo's Lower Bound for Ramsey number R(5,5)
Can genetic algorithms with the symmetric heuristic find the Ramsey number R(5,5)

novelty_claim: Transfer is elevated from a narrative claim to a first-class acceptance test for any structural object.
differentiation: The contribution is the acceptance protocol itself, not just another heuristic benchmark.
